sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं प्रदीप्तानलवर्चसम्।विस्फारयामास तदा कार्मुकं पुरुषर्षभः ।। ६.६७.१२९ ।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ pradīptānalavarcasam।visphārayāmāsa tadā kārmukaṁ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।। 6.67.129 ।।

translations.english: At that time, righteous Lakshmana who was attentively deliberating on many plans to kill Kumbhakarna, said to Rama.
